note: Qwen3-30B-A3B (Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B). Totals are published (30.5B params, bf16, ~61 GB); the per-component split is DERIVED from the published config.json (48 layers, 128 experts, top-8, hidden 2048, moe_intermediate 768, 32 heads / 4 KV heads, vocab 151936) - expert gate/up/down = 3 x 2048 x 768 per expert. Labeled estimate, not a measured budget; regenerate with scripts/checkpoint-budget.py before trusting (that is the methodology rule).

arch.notes: config.json (fetched 2026-10-23): num_hidden_layers 48, num_experts 128, num_experts_per_tok 8, num_attention_heads 32, num_key_value_heads 4, head_dim 128. KV = 2 x 48 x 4 x 128 x 2 B (GQA bf16) = 98,304 B/token. No Engram tables (dense lookup-free arch). Native context 32,768 (YaRN to 131,072).
